Privacy

1. Purpose of Collection and Use of Personal Information

Senscat processes personal information for the following purposes. The personal information being processed is not used for purposes other than those stated below, and if the purpose of use changes, we will take necessary measures such as obtaining separate consent in accordance with Article 18 of the Personal Information Protection Act.

  • Processing and responding to inquiries through contact forms
  • Collecting feedback for service improvement
  • Fulfilling obligations under laws and regulations

2. Personal Information Items Collected

When making inquiries through contact forms, the following information may be collected:

  • Email address
  • Name (optional)
  • Inquiry content

Information automatically collected when visiting the website: IP address, cookies, visit date and time, service usage records, etc.

3. Third-Party Advertising Networks and Cookies

Senscat may use third-party advertising networks including Google AdSense. These advertising networks may use cookies and other technologies to provide ads relevant to users' interests.

Cookies are small text files that websites store on users' browsers. Cookies are used for the following purposes:

  • Storing user preferences and settings
  • Advertising targeting and effectiveness measurement
  • Service usage statistics analysis

Users can refuse the use of cookies through browser settings. However, refusing cookies may limit the use of some services.

4. Retention and Use Period of Personal Information

Collected personal information is, in principle, destroyed without delay after the purpose of collection and use is achieved. However, if there is a need to retain it under relevant laws, it will be kept for the required period.

5. Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties

Senscat, in principle, does not provide users' personal information to external parties. However, exceptions are made in the following cases:

  • When the user has given prior consent
  • When required by law
  • When providing minimum necessary information for service provision (e.g., payment processing companies)

6. Personal Information Protection Officer

If you have any inquiries regarding personal information processing, please contact us below.

Email: sejabi@senscat.com

7. Changes to Privacy Policy

This privacy policy may be updated to reflect changes in laws, policies, or security technologies. Any additions, deletions, or modifications will be notified through the website's notice board 7 days before the implementation date.

Effective Date: February 6, 2025
